description: Get the user's closed trade history across exchanges — entry/exit prices, P&L, and holding duration per trade, with pagination. Use it to review past trades or answer questions about specific fills. Read-only. For aggregate metrics (ROI, win rate, Sortino) use get_performance_metrics instead.

exchange.description: Optional filter by exchange name, e.g. "binance". Omit for all exchanges.

limit.description: Number of trades to return, max 200. Defaults to 50.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Defaults to 1.

symbol.description: Optional filter by trading pair, e.g. "BTC/USDT". Omit for all pairs.

name: get_trade_history
